title: Students
headline: Build an assistant you can defend.
outcome: Leave with a small source set, a working test and one example of when your assistant should decline to answer.

practicum.title: Build an answer you can defend
practicum.exercise: Choose the evidence brief. Use two paragraphs you wrote about a fictional campus event. Ask one answerable question and one whose answer is absent. Complete a skill specification and exchange it with a peer.
practicum.deliverable: A one-page evidence card, two questions, one cited answer, one justified abstention and a revision after review.
practicum.acceptance: A second reader can locate the supported answer and explain why the other question has to remain open.

title: Professors
headline: Teach a lab another lecturer can repeat.
outcome: Choose a learning objective, plan a 90-minute session and take away a rubric for reviewing student work.
invitation: Discuss a guest lecture or facilitated lab

practicum.title: Design and mark a reproducible class exercise
practicum.exercise: Use the 90-minute delivery contract as planning material. Draft three levels of the same exercise on classifying a source claim. Write a hidden edge case and a marking guide. Exchange the exercise with a colleague.
practicum.deliverable: A dated lesson plan, learner handout, marking guide and one change after peer marking.
practicum.acceptance: Two markers can apply the guide to the same synthetic answer, identify a disagreement and record how they resolved it.

title: Researchers
headline: Design a comparison someone else can rerun.
outcome: Write down the baseline, the failure you expect and the observation that would change your conclusion.
invitation: Propose a reproduction or research question

practicum.title: Test when a result can be called accepted
practicum.exercise: Inspect the synthetic research record. Run the five upstream checks. Try promoting the example to accepted without evidence and explain the rejection. Use the quote protocol to plan a blinded comparison that could fail.
practicum.deliverable: Environment and revision, test output, one negative case and a one-page protocol with an explicit stop condition.
practicum.acceptance: Another reader can rerun the fixture and tell which claims the schema can check and which require an actual experiment.

title: Founders
headline: Find the assumption that could end your pilot.
outcome: Take one customer problem through a prototype brief, a costed comparison and a decision about the next week of work.

practicum.title: Produce an auditable service quote
practicum.exercise: Use the supplied synthetic catalogue and request. Draft a quote for one inspection, submit the same request twice, then reopen and export the draft locally. Inspect which files contain owner-only information.
practicum.deliverable: A local owner packet, the duplicate-intake result and a short decision on what requires human review.
practicum.acceptance: Both intakes resolve to the same ID and revision. The reviewer can trace the amount to the fixture and identify exactly which files are private.

title: Community
headline: Start with a problem your community recognises.
outcome: Prepare a brief that names who benefits, who reviews the prototype and how someone can participate without buying a tool.
